title: Choose the visual world for ONE
question: The roll assigned Course Log. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Course Log
options.lineage: a navigator's chart table: plotted course, fixes, heading changes
options.thesis: GTM strategy as a plotted course: every heading change is pinned to the evidence that forced it.
materials: plotting-pen blue on white work areas
options.viewport: Navy rail with the ONE workspaces; Overview leads with Today's findings; a course strip across the top plots the 90-day strategy, each bend labeled with the learning that caused it.
options.risk: If the course strip is decorative instead of clickable, it reads as a theme.

raised.raise: Signal priority is one fixed magnitude ramp: dot size alone carries importance, everywhere.
Card chrome is deleted: hierarchy comes from the type scale, not boxes.
Today's findings show one finding expanded at a time; the rest wait one key away.
Agent activity rows are live entities: columns never move, state restyles the row in place.

options.label: Lab Notebook
options.lineage: a research lab notebook: hypothesis, evidence, revision, signed and dated
options.thesis: Every ICP and strategy is a dated hypothesis with evidence footnotes and visible revisions.
options.viewport: Sidebar app; Overview reads as today's entries: each finding a numbered hypothesis with confidence, footnoted evidence and a revise action.
options.risk: The closest to what most AI-native GTM tools already look like.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.lineage: metropolitan rail diagram on midnight enamel
options.thesis: Customer journeys and agent handoffs drawn as transit lines with interchanges.
options.viewport: Midnight shell; Funnels and journeys as lines by channel meeting at stations (meeting, opportunity, closed).
options.case: Holds product clarity for multi-touch journeys; weaker on audience identification for daily triage.
options.risk: Beautiful on Funnels, forced on tables and settings.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Every action is a coupon: approved, used or void is stamped on it, and nothing silently disappears.
options.viewport: Action Center as a coupon book: each recommended action a coupon with owner, reason and an approve stamp.
options.case: Holds product clarity for approvals and audit; loses audience identification.
options.risk: Reads novelty if the coupon form leaks past the Action Center.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.viewport: Signal field as a sky chart.
options.risk: Founders do not read their pipeline as astronomy.
options.case: Loses both axes for daily GTM work.
options.kept: One fixed size ramp for importance.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.risk: Dated and sparse for dense GTM data.
options.kept: Hierarchy by type scale, no card chrome.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.risk: Hides the comparisons GTM work depends on.
options.kept: One finding in focus at a time.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.viewport: Agent activity as a departures board.
options.risk: Costume of an instrument on a working screen.
options.kept: Rows update in place; columns never move.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Linear-clean, Attio-dense GTM workspace, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, metric strip, insight feed, side drawer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
